description: Submit the review of your one area. This ends the run.

reach.description: checked when you read the code paths for your area. not reached when you ran out of turns first.

severities.description: One line: the severity of each finding, comma separated, from Critical, High, Medium, Low. Write none when there are no findings.

findings.description: One block per finding, most severe first, or the words No findings. Each block starts with a line '### <title> (<severity>)', then the bullets Where, Exploit path, Fix and Board row.
